source_text.body:
Run mortgage business tasks with a Claude Code assistant
A mortgage professional uses Claude Code with an email account and computer access to prepare rate comparisons, build custom property webpages and coordinate meetings.
·
Sep 7, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
A mortgage professional said they use Claude Code to build multiple business apps despite having no programming background. For this use case, they described a rate comparison and quoting tool that auto-prepares comparisons and creates a single-property webpage customized in the client’s name, plus an agent with its own email and access to their computer that coordinates meeting scheduling and separately emails account executives, personalizes questions, gathers replies, and sends one combined summary back.
How it went
They said the tools replaced paid services, saved thousands of dollars, and made the rate-comparison workflow invaluable for helping customers understand quotes and loan estimates. They did not give specific performance metrics for the quoting pages or scheduling agent.
Worth knowing
The main catch they mention is data security: when building the CRM, they said client data security was their foremost concern.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Help me with my mortgage business. Using [rate sheets or lender files in folder path], prepare a rate comparison for [client scenario] and create a simple custom webpage for [property address] with the key numbers. Also propose meeting times for [people] based on my calendar. Show me every email, invite, or published page before it goes out.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeCode/comments/1w9vxmy/how_i_use_claude_code
